It should set up dynamic link options and create ports and excitations. The code should then create a setup and solve the circuit, pushing excitations to the HFSS model. It should start Mechanical and copy bodies from the HFSS project. The code should get losses from HFSS and assign the convection to Mechanical. Finally, the code should plot the model, solve and plot the thermal results, and release AEDT.
